title: ExpiringItemQuantitySnapshot
description: The complete dated batch state of one item in one business unit. Each message replaces the previous one for the same tenant, business unit and item; a batch absent from the array holds no stock.

businessUnitId.description: The id of the business unit (store) the item's stock is held in

stateAsOf.description: Commit timestamp of the stock transaction that produced this state, ISO-8601 in UTC. Strictly increasing per tenant, business unit and item; a consumer keeps the snapshot with the latest value.

batches.description: One entry per distinct batch identity (batchNumber, businessPartnerId, bestBeforeDate, expirationDate) holding stock. A batch emptied by this transaction appears once with remainingQuantity 0 and is absent from later snapshots.

batchNumber.description: The lot number of the batch

businessPartnerId.description: Identifier of the business partner the batch was received from

bestBeforeDate.description: Best before date as a calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). At least one of bestBeforeDate and expirationDate is set.

expirationDate.description: Expiration date as a calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). At least one of bestBeforeDate and expirationDate is set.

remainingQuantity.description: Quantity of the batch remaining in stock, summed over every stock item sharing this batch identity
